verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a Liveness & Face match step that can be added to verification levels. The docs say it confirms the applicant is a real, live person and matches them to the documents on file. Named defenses include deepfakes, AI-generated images, paper masks, photos of a screen and dolls, and analysts can review liveness results on the applicant profile. Missing for 10: explicit documented defense against printed photos (paper masks are mentioned, not prints), any mention of replayed-video or injection-attack defenses, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the anti-spoofing claims.
